remarks: Escape to your own private woodland retreat! This rustic 1,456 sq ft cabin sits on 10.6 wooded acres in Cherry Creek, NY, offering the perfect setting for a weekend getaway, hunting camp or year-round outdoor escape. Comprised of two parcels, the property features varied terrain, a meandering creek along the lower portion, and trails to explore and enjoy the natural surroundings. Gather around a family firepit, relax on the large deck overlooking the woods and creek below, or head out to nearby public trails for horseback riding, cross-country skiing, snowmobiling, and hiking. Inside, the cabin offers a welcoming open floor plan with a cozy woodstove in the great room, two bedrooms, and a full bath on the main level, plus a spacious open loft providing additional flexibility for sleeping, relaxing, or gathering with family and friends. A full basement and multiple outdoor buildings offer plenty of storage for recreational equipment and outdoor toys. A brand-new septic system being installed is an added bonus. Built in the 1980s as a family vacation home, this property has been the setting for years of warm memories and is ready for its next chapter. Some furnishings may be included, with the dining room table and chairs, and certain personal items excluded. If you're looking for privacy, rustic charm, and room to roam, this unique country getaway is worth a look, centrally located, and an easy drive to Jamestown, Ellicottville, Chautauqua Lake, Seneca-Allegany Casino in Salamanca, Buffalo, Erie, and Ohio.
